about: Style family per artist. Claude's read from artist knowledge, not measured and not stated by Krish. Correct freely.

german_melodic_deep.name: German and Euro melodic deep house
german_melodic_deep.description: Warm, patient, melodic 4/4 at 118-124 BPM: long builds, emotive leads, deep subs. Berlin and the Stil vor Talent / Suol orbit.

sunny_vocal_deep.name: Sunny deep house with a song in it
sunny_vocal_deep.description: The 2013-15 crossover sound: a folk or pop vocal, sax, marimba or plucked hook over a soft deep-house groove. Bright, major, warm.

uk_soulful_club.name: UK and soulful vocal house
uk_soulful_club.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.
artists: Mixed By Dario G & Mark Tucker

global_downtempo.name: Downtempo, trip-hop and global fusion
global_downtempo.description: Under or around 100 BPM, or swung: breakbeats, live instruments, world and Latin elements, electro-swing, cinematic chill.
